observations: O-64: R9 source identity is historical after this successor; its standing raw-bit observation compares the exact independently observing block, allowing unrelated witnesses to evolve. Current stack identity is checked by ready-runtime-acceptance/check.py.
O-65: focused native/target witnesses cover recursive-lock, read-write-lock and fallback classification, before/after collection, with a wrong-class control.

O-66: actual emitted token expression tested with zero, unaligned and non-positive TCR values; each clause omitted separately. Full Lisp calls require a valid immutable owner-supplied TCR before entering a frame.
Locks and streams remain transient and are refused by heap-image loading. Only complex single/double shapes are added to image admission.
The single-Worker profile has no scheduler or cross-Worker synchronization claim. Public stream construction, closure attribution and startup callbacks remain owed.
